把我们带不走的全炸了。

texts.zh: 我们已经制定了多种具有明显优势的计划：我们的特工终于被邀请到一个从事尖端研究的高级别安全分支机构。间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]向我们保证，[root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]的预测显示计划前景良好。
texts.en: We have drawn up various plans which press a clear advantage: our operative has at last been invited to a high-security branch facility engaged in cutting-edge research. Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName] assures us that [root.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] simulations paint a favorable forecast.

texts.zh: 我们的特工现在已经执行了大量的测试行动，其结果与来自间谍首脑[root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]的有利预测高度一致。我们对于觊觎已久的[root.target.GetAdj]上的研究已经完全做好了准备。
texts.en: Our operatives have now performed numerous test runs, the results of which concur with favorable forecasts from Spymaster [root.spynetwork.leader.GetName]. We stand ready to make our attempt on coveted [root.target.GetAdj] research.

texts.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetName]的渗透行为迄今还没有露出任何马脚。

一个特工已经通过公用通道获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，他正慢慢地迂回前进，直到接触[fromfrom.target.GetName]限制访问的中央资料库的终端。一系列复杂的电子幕墙和威慑机关现在已经停摆，研究数据库现在完全暴露在我们面前，时间恰好足够我们进行行动。在我们完成这里的任务之后，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]将重新大门紧闭。
texts.en:
Our infiltration attempt in the [fromfrom.target.GetName] has proceeded flawlessly so far.

A single operative has gained access to the interior of a remote research facility via its utility ducts, having slowly wound their way to a restricted-access terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. A complex series of electronic blinds and bluffs has exposed the research database for just long enough to make our move. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security will clamp down tightly after we're done here.

texts.zh:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

我们的一位特工藏在了一处远程研究设施的货物入口，等待运输人员将其带过几道明显很不充分的[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]安全关卡。一个脑子不好使的[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj]将我们的特工放在了一个能够很轻松够到终端的地方，可以从这里入侵[fromfrom.target.GetName]的中央资料库。

一系列复杂的电子幕墙和威慑机关现在已经停摆，研究数据库现在完全暴露在我们面前，时间恰好足够我们进行行动。在我们完成这里的任务之后，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]将重新大门紧闭。
texts.en:
$operation.1026.desc.intro$

A single operative hid within the goods entrance of a remote research facility, waiting to be couriered past a number of clearly-inadequate [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security measures. An unwitting [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesAdj] has placed our operative within easy reach of a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository.

A complex series of electronic blinds and bluffs has exposed the research database for just long enough to make our move. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security will clamp down tightly after we're done here.

texts.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]科学部门的渗透成功了，但是现在我们的一些特工处于风险之中。

一个特工已经通过公用通道获取了通往一个远程科研设施内部的权限，正试图前往核心区域的一处访问受限制的终端。然而，当他获取[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的权限时，警报触发了。

我们想要的研究数据已经被获取到了，但是我们团队的逃脱计划被打乱了。当前的安全措施十分严密，我们必须小心的思考我们的下一步行动……
texts.en:
Our infiltration of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] science has succeeded, however some of our operatives now appear to be at risk.

They sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its utility ducts, intending to reach a restricted-access terminal at its core. When they accessed the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository, however, an alarm was tripped.

 The research data we desired has already been extracted, but our team's escape plans have been thrown into disarray. Security is coming down hard; we must carefully and promptly consider our next move.

texts.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]科学部门的渗透成功了，但是现在我们的一些特工处于风险之中。

我们的一位特工试图通过货运通道访问某个远程研究设施的内部，货运人员直接将此人输运到了一处可以接入[fromfrom.target.GetName]中央存放室的终端。然而不幸的是，刚打算行动的时候警报就触发了。

我们想要的研究数据已经被获取到了，但是我们团队的逃脱计划被打乱了。当前的安全措施十分严密，我们必须小心的思考我们的下一步行动……
texts.en:
Our infiltration of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] science has succeeded, however some of our operatives now appear to be at risk.

A single operative sought access to the interior of a remote research facility via its goods yard, having themselves delivered straight to a terminal for the [fromfrom.target.GetName] central repository. Unfortunately an alarm appears to have been tripped the moment they made their move.

The research data we desired has already been extracted, but our team's escape plans have been thrown into disarray. Security is coming down hard; we must carefully and promptly consider our next move.

texts.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetName]的渗透行为迄今还没有露出任何马脚。尽管[fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName]执行了必要的安全措施，我们的特工隐蔽工作做得更为彻底：我们制造的信任感给了我们充足的机会窗口。

一系列复杂的电子幕墙和威慑机关现在已经停摆，研究数据库现在完全暴露在我们面前，时间恰好足够我们进行行动。在我们完成这里的任务之后，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]将重新大门紧闭。
texts.en:
Our infiltration attempt in the [fromfrom.target.GetName] has proceeded flawlessly so far. Our operative's cover held throughout, and although the [fromfrom.target.GetSpeciesName] exercised reasonable security: the trust we manufactured was just sufficient to grant us our window of opportunity.

A complex series of electronic blinds and bluffs has exposed the research database for just long enough to make our move. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security will clamp down tightly after we're done here.

texts.zh:
我们对[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]科学部门的渗透成功了，但是现在我们的一些特工处于风险之中。我们的首席特工设法利用一个假身份完成了获取，但是他的身份现在已经被识破了，[fromfrom.target.GetAdj]已经通知了他们的安全部门。

我们想要的研究数据已经被获取到了，但是我们团队的逃脱计划被打乱了。当前的安全措施十分严密，我们必须小心的思考我们的下一步行动……
texts.en:
Our infiltration of [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] science has succeeded, however some of our operatives now appear to be at risk. Our lead operative's cover held long enough to complete their extraction, but their credentials have now been exposed as false. [fromfrom.target.GetAdj] security has been alerted to their presence.

The research data we desired has already been extracted, but our team's escape plans have been thrown into disarray. Security is coming down hard; we must carefully and promptly consider our next move.

label.zh: 找回我们的特工，能找回来多少就找回来多少！
label.en: Retrieve as many of our operatives as possible.

label.zh: 把我们带不走的全炸了。
留一个后门，方便我们随时检索他们未来的研究。
label.en: Give us backdoor-access to their future research.

label.zh: 好机会，我们应该再多抢一点！
label.en: This is an ideal opportunity to seize more!

texts.zh:
我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，偷窃研究成果为他们所用，正在进行的研究已经陷入瘫痪。

我们的团队已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢他们的进度。我们预计需要几个月的时间，我们才能利用已保存的纸面材料，重新整合研究开发进度。
texts.en:
Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown infiltrator has upended many of our data libraries, stealing research for their own use and causing significant delays to our ongoing studies.

Our teams were able to switch to backup systems quite rapidly, but this will slow their progress. It's estimated that months may pass before we're able to re-integrate our research & development processes with the existing corpus.

texts.zh:
我们的研究网络已经被破坏！一个不知名的渗透者已经混淆了相当数量的数据库，偷窃研究成果为他们所用，正在进行的研究已经陷入瘫痪。

我们已经尽快开始使用备用系统，但这将会显著拖慢进度。我们需要几个月的时间才能利用已恢复的研究数据集来重新整合研究开发进度。
texts.en:
Our research networks have been compromised! An unknown entity has infiltrated our data media, stealing research for their own use and causing significant disruption to our ongoing studies.

We were able to engage backup systems quite rapidly, but our progress from here will be slowed down. Months may pass before we're able to smoothly re-integrate research & development with our existing research libraries.
